method: Reviewed the full draft against 20 source URLs, all returning HTTP 200 on 2026-11-02. Korea.kr policy briefing (2015-01-15) of the Seoul YWCA / FTC consumer-group project: 14 brands, 21 products, 10 heat-generating innerwear items measured on average 1.8 C higher absolute heat-generation temperature than the other 11, cotton/viscose-heavy products ran hotter, heat generation requires moisture and negligible activity or dry skin yields little effect, heat generation and insulation are independent, all products passed formaldehyde limits, some blending-ratio labels were wrong, 5 of 10 antibacterial claims showed no effect while 5 products (Shinsegae, Uniqlo, Kolon) showed 90%+. The same briefing's correction annex (reproduced by Mdsdaily/매일안전신문): E-mart Hitfil DZ used a silicone softener for the brushed finish that dropped absorbency to 0 until 7+ washes removed it; the seller removed the moisture-wicking claim from 24,604 units and resumed sales on 2014-12-26, and BYC Bodyheat corrected its claims — the direct official record for the fabric-softener-kills-absorbency mechanism. FTC 2011 corrective order (Korea Textile News): 'warms instantly by 3.3 C' and '18 C warmer than regular underwear' ads by 4 home-shopping sellers were sanctioned; no national standard test method for heat generation existed and dry, inactive skin may see no effect. SBS 2022 (KATRI-commissioned): moisture-heat generation ranks 1-2 went to domestic brands, 20 C rose up to 4 C within 5 minutes, Uniqlo third, Chinese generic lowest with size variance; Segye Ilbo's write-up: insulation (보온율) 1st Uniqlo Ultra Warm 29.1%, 2nd domestic M-brand 28.6%, Uniqlo 3rd/4th in moisture-heat — heat and insulation rank differently. RS-KORAS-FITI-044(2016) (KORAS/Korea Reliability Certification Center, FITI): heat-generation temperature measured at 34 C with RH 40->90% vs blank, wash/dry cycles re-measured every 5 cycles for at least 30 cycles, failure criteria example delta-T 1.5 C or retention 70%, annual washes for winter underwear 10-12. Kaken Test Center (JIS L 1952-1/ISO 18782): delta-Tmax 1.6 C threshold counts as an effective moisture-heat finish, example result 2.8 C. KOTITI ISO standardization news (2014): its test method became the world-first ISO for moisture-heat in 2014-07. KDCA national health portal: cold-wave rules (indoor 18-20 C, humidity 40-50%, wool/silk/synthetic inner layer over cotton, layered clothing, change wet clothes), pruritus page (avoid irritating chemical fibers/wool, moisturize within 3 min after bathing, indoor 20 C with humidification, caffeine/alcohol aggravate), atopic dermatitis page (indoor 20-22 C, 45-55%, cotton/silk clothing, wash new clothes and rinse detergent thoroughly, moisturizer 2-3x daily or 4-5x when dry, 250 g/week adult). SNUH xeroderma page: moisture below 10% of normal, avoid over-cleansing; SNU Bundang Hospital: winter barrier-lipid loss, itch mechanism, progression to asteatotic eczema, nocturnal worsening, shower vicious cycle. Woolmark official factsheet GD2405: wool absorbs up to 35% of its weight in moisture vapour and releases heat while doing so, 1 kg dry wool releases heat equivalent to an electric blanket for 8 hours, 3x post-exercise chilling in synthetics vs wool, moves 25% more moisture than polyester (up to 4 C equivalent); Woolmark newsroom 2025-06-05: NC State 4-year program, merino moisture buffering 96% better than polyester, 45% better than cotton, 26% better than viscose. The Gate (2026-10-12): FTC corrective order against BYC for 30 performance ads (14 heat, 16 antibacterial) lacking substantiation, following the 2022 Uniqlo Airism 153,000,000-won surcharge precedent. KS K 0021 (KATS, last confirmed 2024-12-31): care-label temperatures are maxima, machine-dry symbols 80/60 C. Korean Journal of Environmental Health Sciences 2024;50(2):138-145: innerwear formaldehyde limit 75 mg/kg (outerwear/bedding 300), 102-product survey methodology. KTS certification page: 2018 amendment ended mandatory KC marking for adult apparel, KTS replaces it with voluntary marking, innerwear limits formaldehyde 75 mg/kg, pH 4.0-7.5, arylamine 30. Hong Kong Consumer Council CHOICE 495 (2018-01, via Harper's Bazaar HK): of 20 thermal underwear samples 15 gained insulation after repeated washing, 6 gained up to 20%, Thermo-wave 0.10 -> 0.28 after 30 washes. Coupang verification: all three ranked products opened in-browser on 2026-11-02 with prices, review counts, and rocket delivery confirmed (Marunfive HeatTouch fleece set product 161859966 — 14,960 won, 42% off, 18,440 reviews; SLZenger ultra-microfleece innerwear product 6163191284 — 13,410 won Wow price, 14,480 reviews; Woolpower Crewneck 200 merino product 9708490089 — 114,400 won), and the three freshly issued partner deep links redirect to the correct product IDs with lptag=AF6593875. Plan deviations: (1) the plan's rank-1 suggestion of Spao Warmtech / BYC Bodyheat / TopTen OnAir — Spao and TopTen candidates listed under 100 review counts were weak against the category's top sellers, and BYC is under a fresh FTC corrective order for heat-performance ads without substantiation as of 2026-10, so the verified top-seller Marunfive HeatTouch set (18,440 reviews) was mapped instead; (2) the plan's rank-3 '100% natural merino 200-250 g' — no on-page listing states 100% merino for the Woolpower Crewneck 200 on Coupang, so the copy says 'merino wool fabric' without the 100% claim and the review notes the limit; (3) the plan's 'fabric softener destroys the moisture coating' is grounded in the verified Hitfil silicone-softener record (absorbency 0, recovery after 7+ washes) rather than a generic coating claim; (4) clo-unit insulation values were not available from any official source found, so insulation is compared via measured insulation rates (29.1/28.6%) and the HK Council's clo-scale values 0.10->0.28 instead of a clo table.
